title: Google Cloud (service account with read-only roles, per project)

checks.title: Data Access audit logs (DATA_READ and DATA_WRITE) are on for allServices
checks.scope: The project's IAM policy auditConfigs; a folder or organization audit config that adds log types is not read, and logs excluded by a log sink exclusion are not visible.

checks.title: Each listed boolean organization policy constraint is enforced on the project
checks.scope: The effective policy for each constraint given with --gcp-org-constraints (default iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation, storage.publicAccessPrevention); other constraints are not judged.

checks.title: No enabled user-managed service account key is older than the limit (default 90 days)
checks.scope: User-managed keys of the project's service accounts; Google-managed keys and keys held outside Google Cloud are not seen.

checks.title: No Cloud Storage bucket grants a role to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers
checks.scope: Bucket IAM policies; object ACLs on buckets without uniform bucket-level access and signed URLs are not read.

checks.title: Each Cloud SQL instance has no public IPv4 address
checks.scope: Cloud SQL instances of the project; private-IP reachability through peered networks is not judged.

checks.title: Each Cloud SQL instance accepts only encrypted connections
checks.scope: The instance's sslMode (or requireSsl when sslMode is unset); the TLS version clients negotiate is not visible.

checks.title: No enabled ingress firewall rule allows TCP 22 or 3389 from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0
checks.scope: VPC firewall rules of the project; hierarchical firewall policies and network firewall policies are not read.

checks.title: The Security Command Center API is enabled on the project
checks.scope: The service state of securitycenter.googleapis.com; it does not show which Security Command Center tier or detectors are active.

checks.title: Each symmetric Cloud KMS key rotates automatically every 365 days or less
checks.scope: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT keys of the project in every KMS location; asymmetric and MAC keys, which do not rotate automatically, are not judged.

checks.title: Each private subnetwork has VPC flow logs on
checks.scope: Subnetworks with purpose PRIVATE (or unset); proxy-only and other special-purpose subnets are not judged.
